title: 第1章 带着店铺穿越第2章 开业
content_zh:
第一章 带着店铺穿越
有一款游戏，曾经风靡全球，哪怕是在贫困的非洲，也有大量玩家加入了这款游戏当中。它的名字叫《巅峰》，首次开通东方和西方神话共存，任何职业都能够登顶巅峰，哪怕是一位生活职业转职者。
叶石很幸运，在东方神话和西方神话共存的游戏《巅峰》当中，少数隐藏职业里，获得了一个名为神圣铸剑师的隐藏生活职业。
神圣铸剑师，通晓东西两方神话，这个职业本身没有东方和西方之分。不管是东方神话中的长剑、软剑，亦或者是西方神话里的巨剑、骑士剑，只要是属于剑的范畴，唯有想不到，没有做不到。
叶石很幸运，奔着游戏生财的理想进入《巅峰》，为了完成这个理想而选择了铸剑师这一副职。结果在一次任务当中启动隐藏职业转职任务，传承上代神圣铸剑师，从而神圣铸剑师成了叶石的主要职业。
转职任务说也简单，就是完成上代神圣铸剑师未完成的铸剑，在拥有神圣铸剑师专属神器神圣之锤的情况下，叶石很快将其收尾。
而那经过两代神圣铸剑师才完成的圣剑套件，则被叶石毫不客气的收入囊中，成为日后叶石开店时的镇店之宝。
游戏生财，转职成为神圣铸剑师的叶石没有忘记这一目标，在接收几件铸剑交易，获得足够的金币，以及传出足够的名气时，叶石买下一块适当的地皮，开起了以其命名的叶石剑坊。
开张后叶石剑坊可谓门庭若市，门槛几乎都被踏平了，很快叶石便从一星店铺升级为二星店铺。只是随着《巅峰》玩家等级提升，叶石销售的剑具也提升了等级，同时也遇见了开店铺以来的第一个难题。
三星店铺升级在即，而所需的金币还欠缺两百个金币，与客服交谈一番后，叶石兑换了两百个金币，店铺总算达到了升级要求。
而就在店铺升级之际，却发生了一件大事，叶石连接系统的电脑爆炸了，游戏中的叶石连同店铺一同消失，只剩下一块空地。而现实当中的叶石，也被电脑爆炸后产生的神秘漩涡吸了进去。
如果说，一天之前叶石后悔的事情是那么笨被一个无良客服骗了400块钱给准备升级的店铺充了两百金币，那么现在叶石最后悔的事情，就是为啥当初那么精明只被骗走了400块钱。
2012年，穿越已成主流，街头巷尾谈及的一件事情，就是穿越。没看到连广告都是穿越吗，这叫啥，穿越？不，这是潮流。
叶石很幸运，成为了穿越大军中的一员，醒过来的叶石发现，自己坐在一个店铺的柜台处。
值得兴奋的是，这店铺就是自己升级了的游戏店铺，他终于赶上了穿越大潮，踏上了无数牛B前辈的脚步。感到郁闷的是，被忽悠了400块钱买来的金币，在升级的时候用光了，柜台格子里已经空空如也。
早知道会这样，当初咋就不笨一点，让无良客服把钱全骗走算了。
郁闷了很长一会，叶石才从打击中醒来，穿越没有给叶石带来半点不适，之所以郁闷，还是因为钱的问题。有钱走遍天下，无钱寸步难行，叶石深知这个道理，没钱，是叶石现在最大的窘境。
还好尽管没钱，但店铺里的剑都还在，应该能够换点钱花花。神圣铸剑师是个很牛B职业，尽管叶石只会铸剑，但出口的各类剑具都属一流。抱着从游戏中骗点现钱的伟大理想，叶石开起了武器店铺，从此专心铸剑，打怪升级也只是为了更好的铸剑。
终于叶石赚到了第一桶金，以2:1的兑换率，叶石开始鄙视以往的自己，竟然想着从游戏中骗点现钱，这还伟大理想。从此叶石改正观念，他的伟大理想应该是骗大钱，而不是蝇头小利。
看着店铺内的剑具，叶石心里有了计划，店铺里的剑具需要清点，而外面也要走一走，看究竟是一个新的世界呢，还是依然在游戏里。

叶石心里是期待着这是个新世界来的，毕竟谁也不希望活着游戏里，要是哪一天游戏被哪个黑客黑了，自己岂不是也要跟着遭殃。
这么一想，叶石便有些急不可耐了，原本打算先清点店铺里的剑具，现在想想还是押后再说。
出门就需要用钱，叶石摸了摸口袋，只有几个铜币，升级店铺让叶石一清二白，除了原先打造好的剑具，也就剩下身上仅有的几个铜币。
也不知道消费水平咋样，原来游戏里几个铜币买个面包啃啃，恢复点体力还可以，其余的就啥也做不了了。
走出门口，叶石把店铺的门锁好，游戏里哪怕店铺主人不在，玩家也只能拿走标价的剑具，并且要付清了钱才能拿走。现在叶石可没有这样的期望，尤其是满心希望这不是游戏里，叶石就更不会这么认为了。
锁好门后，叶石才将目光看向大街，还真像那么一回事，看着略带熟悉，但又不同的街道，叶石才松了一口气。
看样子，这里应该不是游戏里，而是一个新的世界。对待新事物，人终会有一种难以忍耐的好奇心，叶石也不例外，在知道这是一个新世界以后，叶石产生了一种探视的想法。
“哟，难道小哥你就是新搬来的武器铺的老板吗？”
这时一个悦耳的女声响起，声音细如黄莺，听上去让人感觉一阵心动，不过等到叶石看过去，却是发出一声叹息。
女子长相太普通了，果然上帝还是公平的，那么美的声音，如果再有个美丽的面孔和身材，就完美的有些过分了。当然，这里必须提一下，叶石不信上帝。
女子是叶石店铺旁边布庄的老板，前几日一家武器铺搬来，没人知道是什么时候搬好的，一连几日也没见人出来。只是听说，似乎这武器铺只有老板一人，现在见到叶石走出来，才让女子发出这样的提问。
“呃，是的，大姐你好。”叶石有些手足无措，不知道该说什么好，初来乍到，第一次面对新世界的人总会有些紧张。
看到叶石的模样，女子又笑了出来，“我叫杜莺，是这布庄的老板，以后我们就是邻居了，小哥可要多关照啊。”
“一定一定。”叶石连忙答应，这才想起自己还没通报姓名，“我叫叶石，请多关照。”
旋即，随着一段交流，叶石和杜莺便熟络了起来。叶石也很光棍，刚开始略显紧张之后，心态就迅速放平，这时已经能和杜莺平心交谈起来。
而经过杜莺的解说，叶石也有些了解这个世界，其实只是了解现在所在的这个城池罢了，不过通过这个城池，确实让叶石知道这个世界的雏形。
叶石现在所在的城池，叫高日城，是日耀帝国的一个中等城池，城主黄海涯是一名七品剑道高手，放在日耀帝国里也算是一名强者了。
这时叶石才知道，原来这个世界虽然也有使用其他武器的人，但剑一直是主导，这发现让叶石兴奋不已，最起码他店铺里的剑不用愁卖不出去了。
而通过旁敲推测，叶石也知道了这个世界共分剑道十二品，十二品之上便是剑圣，至于再上还有没有更高的层次，就不是杜莺能够知道的。
打探消息的同时，叶石也得知了一些不好的情况，例如他所在的地方，是高日城东部第三街区，很不巧的，两天后就是第三街区的税收日。

这个世界的税收可不管你有没有挣钱，即便你关门不做生意，也需要缴税的，人口税和店铺税，最起码也要两三个金币才行。
而叶石现在全身上下只有四个铜币，按照消费调查，买两个馒头再喝杯清茶，好了，名副其实的光棍了。
穷，从出生到现在，叶石第一次这么穷，哪怕当初最落魄的时候，口袋里也拽着十块大元，现在倒好，就只有四个铜币。
看来逛街了解情况，和街区的人打好关系的计划要押后了，和杜莺告别后，叶石冲忙的具，尽早
店铺里，叶石坐在地上，两旁各放着一堆剑具，长的短的粗的细的，什么都有。而叶石从左边拿起一把剑，仔细观摩一番后，颇有见解的点了点头，将它反到了右边的剑堆了，再从左边拿起一把。
周而复返的重复了十几分钟，叶石才一下子倒了下去，眼睛直盯着店铺的天花板。看了那么久，这剑还是看不出多大名堂，尽管这都是他打造出来的。
在游戏里有系统提示，加上店铺有系统分析，几把剑、剑的质量如何、该如何定价，这些都有店铺系统搞定，哪还用得着叶石
。以前叶石可以美其言他是铸剑师，这些小活干了贬身价，而现在，叶石不得不承认自己知识太少。
“要是还有店铺系统该有多好啊。”叶石一片感慨。
“嘀嘀，店主叶石启动店铺系统，店铺系统开始启动，请稍等。”
content_en:
Chapter 1 Traveling through time with a shop
There is a game that was once popular all over the world. Even in impoverished Africa, a large number of players have joined this game. Its name is "Peak", which for the first time allows Eastern and Western myths to coexist. Any profession can reach the peak, even a career changer.
Ye Shi was very lucky. In the game "Apex" where Eastern mythology and Western mythology coexist, one of the few hidden professions was given a hidden life profession called Sacred Swordsmith.
The sacred swordsmith is familiar with the myths of both the East and the West. This profession itself is not divided into East and West. Whether it is the long sword or soft sword in Eastern mythology, or the giant sword or knight sword in Western mythology, as long as it belongs to the category of sword, there is nothing you can't think of.
Ye Shi was lucky enough to enter "Apex" with the ideal of making money through gaming. In order to fulfill this ideal, he chose the secondary position of swordsmith. As a result, a hidden job transfer mission was initiated during a mission to inherit the sacred swordsmith from the previous generation, and the sacred swordsmith became Ye Shi's main profession.
The task of changing jobs is simple, that is, to complete the unfinished sword-making by the previous generation of the Holy Sword Forger. With the Holy Sword Forger’s exclusive artifact, the Holy Hammer, Ye Shi quickly completed it.
The holy sword set, which had taken two generations of holy swordsmiths to complete, was unceremoniously taken into Ye Shi's pocket and became Ye Shi's treasure when he opened a store in the future.
Ye Shi, who made money by playing games and became a sacred swordsmith, did not forget this goal. After receiving several sword-making transactions, obtaining enough gold coins, and becoming famous enough, Ye Shi bought a suitable piece of land and opened the Ye Shi Sword Workshop named after him.
After the opening, Ye Shi Jianfang was full of people, and the threshold was almost leveled. Soon Ye Shi was upgraded from a one-star store to a two-star store. However, as the level of "Apex" players increased, the swords sold by Ye Shi also increased their level, and at the same time, they also encountered their first problem since opening the store.
The Samsung store was about to be upgraded, but the required gold coins were still short of 200 gold coins. After talking with the customer service, Ye Shi exchanged 200 gold coins, and the store finally met the upgrade requirements.
But just as the store was being upgraded, a big thing happened. The computer connected to Ye Shi's system exploded. Ye Shi in the game disappeared together with the store, leaving only an empty space. In reality, Ye Shi was also sucked in by the mysterious vortex generated after the computer exploded.
If the thing that Ye Shi regretted a day ago was that he was so stupid and was defrauded of 400 yuan by an unscrupulous customer service to recharge 200 gold coins for the store that was about to be upgraded, then the thing that Ye Shi regrets the most now is that he was only defrauded of 400 yuan because he was so smart in the first place.
In 2012, time travel has become mainstream, and one of the things talked about on the streets is time travel. Didn’t you see that even the advertisement is about time travel? What is this called, time travel? No, this is the trend.
Ye Shi was lucky enough to become a member of the traveling army. When he woke up, Ye Shi found himself sitting at the counter of a shop.
What is exciting is that this store is his upgraded game store. He has finally caught up with the time travel trend and followed in the footsteps of countless awesome predecessors. What makes me depressed is that the gold coins I was defrauded of 400 yuan were used up during the upgrade, and the counter grid was already empty.
If I had known this would happen, why wouldn't I have been stupid and let the unscrupulous customer service cheat me out of all my money?
After being depressed for a long time, Ye Shi woke up from the shock. Time travel did not bring any discomfort to Ye Shi. The reason why he was depressed was because of the money issue. If you have money, you can travel all over the world, but if you don't have money, you can't move anywhere. Ye Shi knows this truth very well. Having no money is Ye Shi's biggest dilemma now.
Fortunately, even though I have no money, the swords in the shop are still there, so I should be able to exchange them for some money. The Holy Swordsmith is an awesome profession. Although Ye Shi only knows how to make swords, all kinds of swords exported areFirst class. With the great ideal of making some cash from the game, Ye Shi opened a weapons shop and concentrated on making swords from then on, fighting monsters and upgrading just to make better swords.
Finally, Ye Shi made his first pot of gold. With an exchange rate of 2:1, Ye Shi began to despise his past self. He even thought of cheating some cash from the game. This was a great ideal. From then on, Ye Shi changed his mind. His great ideal should be to make big money, not to make small profits.
Looking at the swords and tools in the shop, Ye Shi had a plan in mind. The swords and tools in the shop needed to be checked, and he also had to take a walk outside to see if it was a new world or still in the game.
Ye Shi was looking forward to this new world in his heart. After all, no one wanted to be alive in the game. If the game was hacked by a hacker one day, wouldn't he also suffer the same?
Thinking of this, Ye Shi became a little impatient. He originally planned to take inventory of the swords in the shop, but now he thought about it and postponed it.
Money was needed when going out. Ye Shi touched his pocket and found only a few copper coins. Upgrading the shop made Ye Shi clear. Apart from the originally made sword, he only had a few copper coins left.
I don’t know what the consumption level is. It turns out that in the game, I can buy a piece of bread with a few copper coins and chew it to restore some physical strength, but I can’t do anything else.
After walking out of the door, Ye Shi locked the door of the shop. In the game, even if the owner of the shop is not there, the player can only take away the sword with a price tag, and the price must be paid in full before taking it away. Now Ye Shi has no such expectations, especially since he fully hopes that this is not in the game, Ye Shi even less thinks so.
After locking the door, Ye Shi looked at the street. It was really like that. Looking at the slightly familiar but different street, Ye Shi breathed a sigh of relief.
It seems that this is not a game, but a new world. People will always have an unbearable curiosity when dealing with new things, and Ye Shi is no exception. After knowing that this is a new world, Ye Shi had the idea of ​​​​visiting it.
"Hey, brother, are you the boss of the newly moved weapons shop?"
At this time, a pleasant female voice sounded, as thin as an oriole, which made people feel heartbeat, but when Ye Shi looked over, he let out a sigh.
The woman's appearance is too ordinary. Sure enough, God is still fair. With such a beautiful voice, if she has a beautiful face and body, it would be too perfect. Of course, it must be mentioned here that Ye Shi does not believe in God.
The woman is the owner of the cloth shop next to Ye Shi's shop. A weapons shop moved in a few days ago. No one knows when it was moved. No one came out for several days. I just heard that it seemed that there was only one owner of this weapons shop. Now that she saw Ye Shi coming out, the woman asked such a question.
"Uh, yes, hello, eldest sister." Ye Shi was a little at a loss and didn't know what to say. People who have just arrived and faced a new world for the first time are always a little nervous.
Seeing Ye Shi's appearance, the woman laughed again, "My name is Du Ying, and I am the owner of this cloth shop. We will be neighbors from now on, so please take more care of me."
"Absolutely." Ye Shi agreed quickly, then remembered that he hadn't informed me of his name yet, "My name is Ye Shi, please take care of me."
Immediately, following a conversation, Ye Shi and Du Ying became familiar with each other. Ye Shi was also a bachelor. After being a little nervous at first, he quickly calmed down and was able to talk to Du Ying calmly.
After Du Ying's explanation, Ye Shi also had some understanding of the world. In fact, he only knew the city where he was now, but through this city, Ye Shi did know the prototype of the world.
The city where Ye Shi is now is called Gaoricheng, which is a medium-sized city in the Sun Yao Empire. The city owner Huang Haiya is a seventh-level swordsman, and he can be considered a strong man in the Sun Yao Empire.
Only then did Ye Shi know that the originalAlthough there are people who use other weapons in this world, swords have always been dominant. This discovery made Ye Shi very excited. At least the swords in his shop no longer have to worry about being sold.
And through extrapolation, Ye Shi also knew that the world was divided into twelve levels of swordsmanship, and those above the twelve levels were sword masters. As for whether there was a higher level beyond that, Du Ying was not able to know.
While inquiring about the information, Ye Shi also learned some bad things. For example, the place he was in was the third block in the east of Gaori City. Unfortunately, the tax day of the third block was in two days.
The taxes in this world don't matter whether you make money or not. Even if you close your business and don't do business, you still need to pay taxes. The population tax and shop tax cost at least two or three gold coins.
Ye Shi now only has four copper coins in his body. According to the consumption survey, if he buys two steamed buns and drinks a cup of tea, then he is truly a bachelor.
Poor, Ye Shi was so poor for the first time since he was born. Even when he was at his lowest, he still had ten yuan in his pocket, but now he only had four copper coins.
It seems that the plan of going shopping to understand the situation and establishing good relations with the people in the neighborhood will be postponed. After bidding farewell to Du Ying, Ye Shichong hurriedly went to work as soon as possible.
In the shop, Ye Shi was sitting on the ground, with a pile of swords on both sides, long, short, thick, and thin. Ye Shi picked up a sword from the left. After observing it carefully, he nodded with insight, put it back on the sword pile on the right, and then picked up another one from the left.
After repeating this for more than ten minutes, Ye Shi suddenly fell down and stared at the ceiling of the shop. After looking at it for so long, I still can't see how fancy this sword is, even though it was all made by him.
There are system prompts in the game, and the store has a system analysis, how many swords, what is the quality of the sword, and how to price it. These are all handled by the store system, so there is no need for Ye Shi.
. In the past, Ye Shi could plausibly say that he was a swordsmith, but doing these small jobs had devalued his status. But now, Ye Shi had to admit that he had too little knowledge.
"It would be great if there was a store system." Ye Shi sighed with emotion.
"Didi, the store owner Ye Shi has started the store system. The store system is starting. Please wait a moment."
